ideas.pitch: An edge-AI powered smart waste sorting mechanism using computer vision to classify and segregate dry, wet, and hazardous waste on a conveyor belt in real-time.
ideas.title: SmartBins AI: Edge-Powered Dynamic Garbage Sorting Robot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hardware hackathons heavily reward physical prototypes that have a working sensor-to-actuator closed loop, directly replicating the success of proven robotics projects.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-software digital twin platform that monitors cell voltage, temperature, and current of lithium-ion battery packs, predicting degradation and preventing thermal incidents.
ideas.title: VoltTwin: IoT Battery Health & Thermal Runaway Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical sensor telemetry with an intuitive digital dashboard, echoing the architecture of multi-award-winning industrial IoT systems.

ideas.pitch: A hybrid monitoring system combining satellite data verification with on-site IoT air and soil sensors to flag environmental violations around industrial zones.
ideas.title: GeoSentinel: Satellite & IoT Industrial Land Compliance Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies geospatial multi-modal validation to real-world infrastructure problems, following the exact blueprint of recent top-tier hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A low-power ESP32-based mesh network of agricultural sensor pods that automates drip irrigation valves using local machine learning thresholds for optimal water retention.
ideas.title: AgriGuard: Autonomous Soil Moisture & Micro-Irrigation Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent agricultural automation problem with low-cost microcontrollers, ensuring high impact and practical deployment potential for judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated electrical circuit breaker diagnostic board that uses multi-sensor anomaly detection to isolate short circuits and report exact fault coordinates over an MQTT broker.
ideas.title: SafeGrid: Multi-Agent Electrical Fault Isolation System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates real-time hardware safety intervention with instant software feedback, fulfilling the core criteria of a robust engineering prototype.
